author: dimension11studios
title: Hiring Character Artist for Legends of Orisha
content: WE'RE HIRING! We're looking for a Character Artist to join the team working on Legends of Orisha: Blood and Water. If you're skilled in 3D character modelling, sculpting, texturing, and Unreal Engine, this could be a great fit! Experience with MetaHuman, realistic 4C hair, African hairstyles, and character materials is a big plus. Remote. Long-term collaboration. Interested? Find the full job description and application details through the link in our bio.

author: eunoians
title: Immediate Openings for Illustrators
content: IMMEDIATE OPENINGS - ILLUSTRATORS | COMPOSITORS | EDITORS | AI EXPERTS. We’re looking for creative people with an eye for detail and a passion for bringing ideas to life. Illustrators: Figma knowledge is a plus. Send your profile to join@eunoians.com. Applications and queries via email only. No calls or WhatsApp messages, please.

author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring Comic Artists, Lineartists and More
content: HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE. We’re looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects. These positions include: Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, animators, music producers, language translators, comic writers/editors, personal assistants, video/reel editors/promoters, content creators & more. These positions are paid but we’re open to collaboration / internships. Please send a PROFESSIONAL email to: whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com with name, location, position, resume/portfolio, rates, turnaround, software, payment method. NO DEADLINE, ROLLING APPLICATION ACCEPTANCE. ABSOLUTELY NO AI USE.

author: philfalcowrites
title: Paid Comic Work for TRANSPHORIA Anthology
content: PAID COMIC WORK: Apply to be a Writer or Artist in the next volume of Ringo Award-winning comic anthology: TRANSPHORIA! No previous experience required (we love working with industry veterans AND fresh faces). Absolutely no costs to apply/contribute. Paid work for accepted contributors. Creators retain rights to their stories! Application Deadline: December 21, 2026! Link in @philfalcowrites bio!
